input: Find city and county Parks & Recreation and community-center summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville parks recreation summer camps 2026 community centers
Black Mountain parks recreation summer camp 2026
Madison Yancey Mitchell county parks recreation summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 youth camps at Montford, Shiloh, Southside and Stephens-Lee centers; teen and adaptive programs; 2027 details due February 1.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach welcomes children and teens of all backgrounds; summer 2027 begins June 14.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.town: Asheville, Candler, Hendersonville and Bryson City
candidates.note: Summer day camps include Explorer and Adventure programs; Camp Watia offers overnight camp near Bryson City.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Weekly June–August camps for rising first–sixth graders include exploration, crafts and STEM projects.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp included field trips, swimming, crafts, sports and nature activities.

candidates.name: Town of Mills River Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Two youth summer tennis camps with drills, games and skill instruction for all levels.

candidates.name: Town of Canton Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer camp at Recreation Park includes outdoor games, crafts and swimming, with groups divided by rising grade.

candidates.name: Transylvania County Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2025 summer camps for local children included field trips within and beyond the county.

candidates.name: Jackson County Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 youth summer day camp for ages 6–12 included games, crafts, field trips and pool trips.

candidates.name: City of Morganton Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included traditional summer camps, a younger-child mini-camp and a one-day adaptive IDAP! camp.

candidates.name: City of Morganton Department of Public Safety
candidates.note: Free Safe Haven Summer Camp for fifth graders, starting each day at Collett Street Recreation Center; 2026 flyer found.

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 Jump Start JC summer day camp at Memorial Park Community Center served ages 6–12 during June and July.

candidates.name: Greenville County Parks, Recreation & Tourism
candidates.note: 2026 Slater Hall Community Center summer day camp for ages 6–11 included field trips, games, crafts, music and sports.
